meta.name: Power Rangers Jungle Fury
meta.description: Three teenagers from the Pai Zhug Kung Fu Academy are chosen to fight the forces of an opposing academy and all other forces of evil.

videos.name: Welcome to the Jungle (1)
videos.overview: Theo, Lily and rookie Casey are chosen to become the latest guardians of Dai Shi, an ancient imprisoned spirit.
videos.description: Theo, Lily and rookie Casey are chosen to become the latest guardians of Dai Shi, an ancient imprisoned spirit.

videos.name: Welcome to the Jungle (2)
videos.overview: With Mantor still plaguing the city, the Rangers are in desperate need of learning the ability to bring themselves up to his size.
videos.description: With Mantor still plaguing the city, the Rangers are in desperate need of learning the ability to bring themselves up to his size.

videos.name: Sigh of the Tiger
videos.overview: Casey requests extra training from RJ, the spirit of the buffalo is harnessed for evil, and Fran protects the pizza parlor from a children's party.
videos.description: Casey requests extra training from RJ, the spirit of the buffalo is harnessed for evil, and Fran protects the pizza parlor from a children's party.

videos.name: A Taste of Poison
videos.overview: The Five Fingers of Poison are brought forth by Dai Shi, who doubly stuns the Rangers by finally revealing his human form to be the face of Jarrod.
videos.description: The Five Fingers of Poison are brought forth by Dai Shi, who doubly stuns the Rangers by finally revealing his human form to be the face of Jarrod.

videos.name: Can't Win Them All
videos.overview: The second Finger of Poison, Gakko, uses his wall-sticking skills to humiliate the Rangers when they try to face him on his own turf.
videos.description: The second Finger of Poison, Gakko, uses his wall-sticking skills to humiliate the Rangers when they try to face him on his own turf.

videos.name: Dance the Night Away
videos.overview: The friendship between Theo and Lily is tested by the Yellow Ranger's budding platonic relationship with Casey.
videos.description: The friendship between Theo and Lily is tested by the Yellow Ranger's budding platonic relationship with Casey.

videos.name: Pizza Slice of Life
videos.overview: With RJ out of town, Casey is left in charge of Jungle Karma Pizza. Instead of asserting himself as the boss, he creates chaos in the pizza parlor.
videos.description: With RJ out of town, Casey is left in charge of Jungle Karma Pizza. Instead of asserting himself as the boss, he creates chaos in the pizza parlor.

videos.name: Way of the Master
videos.overview: The heavily armored Pangolin proves to be too tough of a nut for the Rangers to crack. Their only hope is a powerful weapon called the Jungle Mace.
videos.description: The heavily armored Pangolin proves to be too tough of a nut for the Rangers to crack. Their only hope is a powerful weapon called the Jungle Mace.

videos.name: Good Karma, Bad Karma
videos.overview: Casey loses his $5 tip to a young boy named Josh, who wants to buy himself a kite.
videos.description: Casey loses his $5 tip to a young boy named Josh, who wants to buy himself a kite.

videos.name: Blind Leading the Blind
videos.overview: Theo spreads his focus too thin, leading his teammates to question his effectiveness in battle. Blind Master Swoop teaches him Bat Spirit techniques.
videos.description: Theo spreads his focus too thin, leading his teammates to question his effectiveness in battle. Blind Master Swoop teaches him Bat Spirit techniques.

videos.name: Pushed to the Edge
videos.overview: Believing that Carnisoar's training methods are too harsh, Camille decides to find him a new master and revives Jellica, the Sea Overlord.
videos.description: Believing that Carnisoar's training methods are too harsh, Camille decides to find him a new master and revives Jellica, the Sea Overlord.

videos.name: One Master Too Many
videos.overview: Casey anxiously awaits the arrival of his second master, but RJ begins to feel forgotten as a result.
videos.description: Casey anxiously awaits the arrival of his second master, but RJ begins to feel forgotten as a result.

videos.name: Ghost of a Chance (1)
videos.overview: After another victorious battle against Camille's monsters, the Rangers feel they are unstoppable. But RJ warns them about being overconfident.
videos.description: After another victorious battle against Camille's monsters, the Rangers feel they are unstoppable. But RJ warns them about being overconfident.

videos.name: Ghost of a Chance (2)
videos.overview: With RJ captured, the Rangers must travel to the spirit world to find the last three remaining masters.
videos.description: With RJ captured, the Rangers must travel to the spirit world to find the last three remaining masters.

videos.name: Bad to the Bone
videos.overview: Everyone makes fun of Lily for being too nice. Lily gets fed up and starts to show her bad side, refusing to help the other Rangers.
videos.description: Everyone makes fun of Lily for being too nice. Lily gets fed up and starts to show her bad side, refusing to help the other Rangers.

videos.name: Friends Don't Fade Away
videos.overview: After his last battle, RJ has major problems controlling his animal spirit. He turns into a werewolf and becomes a big threat to anyone around him.
videos.description: After his last battle, RJ has major problems controlling his animal spirit. He turns into a werewolf and becomes a big threat to anyone around him.

videos.name: No "I" in Leader
videos.overview: Casey really has grown and stepped up to being the leader of the group. But now, with RJ as a Ranger, Casey feels like a cub all over again.
videos.description: Casey really has grown and stepped up to being the leader of the group. But now, with RJ as a Ranger, Casey feels like a cub all over again.

videos.name: True Friends, True Spirits
videos.overview: Grizzaka sends an evil spirit to cause trouble between RJ and his animal spirit again. The hero in RJ causes him to save Flit.
videos.description: Grizzaka sends an evil spirit to cause trouble between RJ and his animal spirit again. The hero in RJ causes him to save Flit.

videos.name: Path of the Rhino
videos.overview: Dominic was sent out by Master Mao to find purpose for his life. He finds out that RJ and the others are Power Rangers and he wants to join them.
videos.description: Dominic was sent out by Master Mao to find purpose for his life. He finds out that RJ and the others are Power Rangers and he wants to join them.

videos.name: Dash for the Dagger
videos.overview: Jarrod has found the Rhino Nexus. Dominic is startled by a dream telling him to protect the Control Dagger, as it holds the key to his destiny.
videos.description: Jarrod has found the Rhino Nexus. Dominic is startled by a dream telling him to protect the Control Dagger, as it holds the key to his destiny.

videos.name: Race to the Nexus
videos.overview: The Overlords won't grant the Nexus to the Rangers. Yet, having searched all his life for his destiny, Dominic won't let them stand in his way.
videos.description: The Overlords won't grant the Nexus to the Rangers. Yet, having searched all his life for his destiny, Dominic won't let them stand in his way.

videos.name: Arise the Crystal Eyes
videos.overview: The Phantom Beasts were a notorious force in the Beast Wars. The crystal eyes hold the power to bring back these Phantom Beasts.
videos.description: The Phantom Beasts were a notorious force in the Beast Wars. The crystal eyes hold the power to bring back these Phantom Beasts.

videos.name: Fear and the Phantoms
videos.overview: The Phantom Beasts have been brought back to life. Dai Shi has them prove their loyalty by capturing the three masters.
videos.description: The Phantom Beasts have been brought back to life. Dai Shi has them prove their loyalty by capturing the three masters.

videos.name: Blue Ranger, Twin Danger
videos.overview: The Phantom Beasts call forth the Spirit Rangers, who look and fight exactly like Power Rangers. Our heroes are in for a real fight!
videos.description: The Phantom Beasts call forth the Spirit Rangers, who look and fight exactly like Power Rangers. Our heroes are in for a real fight!

videos.name: One Last Second Chance
videos.overview: To stop the Spirit Rangers, RJ risks destroying his father. Trusting his instincts, he finds that his dad was prepared if this should happen.
videos.description: To stop the Spirit Rangers, RJ risks destroying his father. Trusting his instincts, he finds that his dad was prepared if this should happen.

videos.name: Don't Blow That Dough
videos.overview: The Rangers get sucked into a cheesy game show about the past season. Camille hosts the game show and a wrong answer could result in being canceled!
videos.description: The Rangers get sucked into a cheesy game show about the past season. Camille hosts the game show and a wrong answer could result in being canceled!

videos.name: Tigers Fall, Lions Rise
videos.overview: Dai Shi becomes the Phantom Beast King. Weakened with the loss of his spirit, Casey must summon all the energy he has left to stay alive.
videos.description: Dai Shi becomes the Phantom Beast King. Weakened with the loss of his spirit, Casey must summon all the energy he has left to stay alive.

videos.name: The Spirit of Kindness
videos.overview: Whiger was only able to steal the Tiger Spirit from Casey, but not destroy Casey. For his failure, Dai Shi strips him of his power.
videos.description: Whiger was only able to steal the Tiger Spirit from Casey, but not destroy Casey. For his failure, Dai Shi strips him of his power.

videos.name: Maryl and the Monkeys
videos.overview: Camille steals a cloning formula from Maryl. The monkeys duplicate and Camille's plan just might work, but Scorch and Snapper sabotage her plan.
videos.description: Camille steals a cloning formula from Maryl. The monkeys duplicate and Camille's plan just might work, but Scorch and Snapper sabotage her plan.

videos.name: To Earn Your Stripes
videos.overview: The day has arrived for the three to get their master stripes. Lily and Theo pass the test to become masters. Casey does not.
videos.description: The day has arrived for the three to get their master stripes. Lily and Theo pass the test to become masters. Casey does not.

videos.name: Path of the Righteous
videos.overview: Nobody believes him, but Casey knows that Jarrod still lives inside of Dai Shi. He goes off on his own to save Jarrod.
videos.description: Nobody believes him, but Casey knows that Jarrod still lives inside of Dai Shi. He goes off on his own to save Jarrod.

videos.name: Now the Final Fury
videos.overview: A new war is about to begin as Dai Shi opens a vortex and resurrects all his fallen warriors. Outnumbered, the Rangers do their best to battle evil.
videos.description: A new war is about to begin as Dai Shi opens a vortex and resurrects all his fallen warriors. Outnumbered, the Rangers do their best to battle evil.
